propositions: Within a single _run_opengrep invocation, semgrep --validate is called exactly once per unique detector source_path instead of once per detector, reducing duplicate validation of shared sources
A shared-source validation failure correctly quarantines every detector declared from that source as invalid_detector with per-detector detail preserved
The validation cache is call-local only with no module-level, persistent, or cross-scan state introduced
Option (b) cross-worker scan-result reuse is explicitly out of scope and filed separately to preserve analyzer boundaries and avoid stale-result risk under xdist
